LanguageData.Lumen_Solar_Hysteresis: Stored energy needed to recover from depletion
LanguageData.Lumen_Solar_NetworkRule: Every Sunstone collector and battery on a map shares one Solar network, however far apart. Charge is lost if it is destroyed or deconstructed, and kept if it is minified and reinstalled.
LanguageData.Lumen_Solar_OutputDesc: Under a clear midday sky. Less in fog, rain and storms, at dawn and dusk, and under a roof, and none at night. Surplus fills the network's batteries.
